title: From a Dream Board to a $28 Million Deal
description:
A reported 28 million dollar shoe deal. Before her first pro game.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Caitlin Clark: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caitlin_Clark

From Wikipedia (Caitlin Clark): NCAA Division I all-time leading scorer at Iowa; the 2023 national championship game was the most-viewed women's college basketball game ever (9.9 million); first pick of the 2024 WNBA draft; after the draft in April 2024, The Wall Street Journal and The Athletic reported a pending eight-year, $28 million Nike deal, the largest sponsorship for a women's basketball player; her signature basketball features phrases from her dream board: "Play in the WNBA" and "Get a basketball scholarship". Not financial advice.

#shorts #caitlinclark #wnba #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you write down a dream, remember:
cta: Clark or Curry? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: A reported 28 million dollar shoe deal. Before her first pro game.
As a kid, her dream board said: get a basketball scholarship.
She got it. Then became college basketball's all-time top scorer.
Then pick one in 2024. Eight years, 28 million, reported.
And those dream board words? Now printed on her own basketball.
